title: Keep converter correlation visible when only marginals are known
statement: With separate dark/bright marginal click probabilities q0,q1, wrong single-click mass lies only between max(0,q0-q1) and min(q0,1-q1); the product q0(1-q1) additionally requires matched independence.

requires: Consistent PSD kernels on every finite family in the visited span
Explicit declared passive collection and detector model
provides: A usable conservative joint-event range without a false independent-click assumption
assumptions: The source counterexample is a probability coupling, not an acquired adverse physical converter
Use an actual joint instrument to sharpen the range
costs: Acquire correlations or retain the full marginal range
contract.units: Dimensionless probabilities/Bell loss/half-diamond error as explicitly stated; source calls, resets, memory and control gates are separate costs.
contract.obstruction: Marginal calibration does not determine the joint failure event.

evidence.quote: # Continuum coherent packets as certified quantum instruments
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: Finite samples of independently plausible kernels do not supply consistency on the full visited span. Ideal passive collection/threshold effects exclude undeclared dark counts, dead time, nonlinear readout and reset models. Joint no-click is Gamma(I-sum E_r), not a product of pulled-back no-click effects. No independent converter joint probability follows from separate marginals. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Completed acquired conditional detector proof reading; the frozen original proof hash was computed at preservation, not attested in that reviewer message. The independently pinned root review also covers its detector section.
